scope: Proposition 6.3 (Matched seeds and finite observations) of the manuscript “Generic Future Inextendibility with Square-Integrable Connection Near a Fixed Kerr Spacetime” (preprints/Generic-Future-Inextendibility-with-Square-Integrable-Connection-Near-a-Fixed-Kerr-Spacetime-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1518c8e1e86bb532), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For v ∈ T + J0, use the same numerical states (6.9) in gT on its future unit shell. Their backward geodesics give maps ΨT,v : O0 → O with sup v∈T+J0 ∥ΨT,v − incl ∥C1 −→ 0. (6.10) Write δT for the left side of (6.10). Each map is injective and preserves the corresponding section measure: Ψ∗ T,vµdT = µd on O0. In particular Hv(O0) has canonical volume µd(O0) for every such v. Put rT = e−κT , F = (∂u, r−1 T ∂v, ∂θ1 , ∂θ2 ). (6.11) For g and gT on the larger observation box, the Gram matrices in F and their inverses are uniformly bounded and nondegenerate. Their ordinary coordinate jets through order thirty are eo(T). The selected unit tangent is bounded in F, all state momenta lie in one bounded box, and crT du dv d2 θ ≤ d volg, d volgT ≤ CrT du dv d2 θ. (6.12) For each fixed finite T and each ηmap > 0, these observations persist for all data in a sufficiently small relative weighted smooth neighborhood of dT , with signal lower bound AT in place of 2AT . The persisted common coordinates need not be optical. The canonical section volume, injective maps into O, and frame and density bounds persist. Their backward maps satisfy sup v∈T+J0 ∥b ΨT,v − ΨT,v∥C1 < ηmap, sup v∈T+J0 ∥b ΨT,v − incl ∥C1 ≤ δT + ηmap. The neighborhood may depend on T and ηmap.
